description: Established in 2015 by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh, Govt. College Makdone is affiliated with Vikram University, Ujjain. It currently operates from the Government Ravindra Higher Secondary School building in Makdone while its own building is under construction. The official site describes arts, science and commerce faculties.
